Place them in a soup bowl and pour boiling strong beef broth over them.

title: Polévka s knedlíčky z mozku (Soup with Calf's Brain Quenelles)
description: A soup made with pork, bread, and egg yolk.
steps: Clean calf or pork brain thoroughly and cook it in salted water, remove the skin and chop it finely with parsley, add salt and a little ground pepper, then lightly fry everything in butter.
Put it in a mortar, add a slice of white bread soaked in milk and mash together finely, or rub well in a bowl with a spoon.

Take sorrel, yarrow, strawberry leaves, violet leaves, caraway leaves, primrose, chicory, chervil, green parsley, young green onions, watercress, mache, clean everything well and rinse in several waters
Then on a board chop it finely and let cook in salted water until soft
Then in a small pot mix a piece of butter, three spoonfuls of flour, three egg yolks and three spoonfuls of cold cream
Pour it into the soup, whisk well — but it must not cook any longer — and pour into a bowl on fried bread cubes

title: Polévka z úhoře (Eel Soup)
description: A soup made with eel, white wine, and crayfish.
steps: Clean and skin the eel, trim the meat from the backbone and cut into pieces the size of oysters
Place in a pan with two tablespoons of butter, two glasses of white wine, salt and pepper and let it braise for a quarter hour
Remove the eel and place in a soup bowl with three dozen cooked and shelled crayfish tails
In a pot put two sliced carrots, two onions, parsley and celery root, a sprig of thyme, bay leaf, three cloves, a handful of whole pepper, two pieces of dill and four ounces of butter
Mix and let it steam

Add meat from crayfish, crushed meat from one small lobster, heads, bones and trimmings from the eels, a little salt, three quarts of water, a pint of white wine and eel sauce and let it all simmer slowly for about an hour
Skim the foam and fat, strain first through a sieve then through cloth
Thicken with a pale roux, let it simmer another quarter hour, skim the foam
Bind with four egg yolks mixed with a cup of cream and two tablespoons of butter and pour into the bowl over the pieces of eel and crayfish tails
If you do not have crayfish tails, you can use sliced lobster tail

title: Postní bouillon (Fish Bouillon)
description: A soup made with celery, onions, and carrot.
steps: Grease an appropriate pot with fresh butter
Put in the pot 1.5 celery roots, 2 parsley roots, 2 Spanish onions, 1 carrot, and 2 garlic cloves, all cut up
Add 2 cleaned, gutted pike, the head of pike, and the head of bream or carp
Add 3 handfuls of peas
Let simmer slowly until the juices turn golden
Pour in 2 quarts of boiling water
Add 4 bay leaves, 5 cloves, a piece of ginger, several grains of white pepper, enough salt, a little saffron, and flowers
Cover the pot well and let boil for about 2 hours
Remove from heat and let stand quietly for about half an hour
Slowly strain through a cloth into an earthenware pot without clouding it
If using the bouillon for sauces and other fasting soups, keep it in a cool place, otherwise serve it hot in cups

For the first 14 days, shake the pot occasionally so the plums sink to the bottom.
It is best to seal the pot with some fat so that air cannot enter.

steps: Take a stone vessel and pour half a liter of good wine vinegar into it

title: Rejžová polévka na způsob krupovky (Cream of Rice)
description: Prepared with rice, beef broth, and hen.
steps: Pick over one coffee cup of rice and clean it several times in boiling water.
Dissolve two spoons of flour in fresh water, add this to the rice, then pour good beef broth over it, in which (if possible) half an old hen has been cooked.

Then strain the broth through a fine sieve and place it back on the fire until it comes to a boil again; before bringing to the table, beat four egg yolks in three spoons of sour cream and mix them in.

title: Rýže s uzeninkou (Rice with Smoked Meat)
description: Prepared with rice, meat, and beef broth or water.

If there is young peas, add it, which was braised in butter with a piece of sugar.

title: Rýžová kaše (Boiled Rice)
description: Prepared with rice, melted butter, and prunes.

Pour a quart of milk over it and let it cook with frequent stirring
When cooked, salt it, turn out onto a dish
Sprinkle with ground cinnamon and sugar and pour hot fresh melted butter over it

title: Rýžová polévka (Consommé with Rice)
description: A soup made with rice, beef, and parmesan cheese.
steps: Pick over the rice and rinse it several times in lukewarm water.
Put in a pot, pour two quarts of clear beef soup over it, salt, add a little flower and a piece of fresh butter.
Let simmer slowly for half an hour until rice softens, taking care that the rice does not burn and does not become mushy when stirring.
If desired, serve with a plate of grated Parmesan cheese on the side.

title: Rýžová polévka (Rice Soup)
description: A soup made with rice, mushrooms, and cream.

ingredients.name: An eighth of a kilogram (quarter pound) rice

Drain the water and pour in fresh water
Add a piece of new butter, a little flower, pepper, and salt
Braise the rice so it doesn't burn, pouring water over it
When soft, pour 2 liters of water over it

title: Rýžový nákyp (Puffed Rice Pudding)
description: A pudding made with rice, milk or cream, and egg yolks.

ingredients.name: cleaned and well-rinsed rice
ingredients.sourceText: one cup of cleaned and well-rinsed rice

steps: Cook the rice in milk or cream into a thick porridge
Let it cool
Add {{source-2}}
Add eight egg yolks
Add half a cup of sugar
Add a little vanilla
Add a little grated lemon rind
Add a pinch of salt
Stir for fifteen minutes
Gradually fold in the stiff snow made from eight egg whites
Pour immediately into a mold
Dust with sugar
Bake in the oven for three-quarters of an hour
Dust with sugar again and bring to table
Sago pudding is prepared in the same way

title: Rýžový nákyp ještě na jiný způsob (Rice Pudding, Yet Another Way)
description: A pudding made with rice, bread, and raisins.
steps: Cook a small cup of rice in one quart of milk
When cooked, let it cool
Toast finely grated hard wheat bread in butter until golden
Beat five eggs
Butter a mold for a bábovka cake with cold butter
Sprinkle the bread around the inside so the rice does not stick
Put a two-finger-thick layer of rice around the bottom
Add a layer of beaten eggs
Then add a layer of raisins, cinnamon, and sugar
Grease with butter and start layering rice again
Repeat this three times
Bake slowly in the oven

title: Rýžový nákyp na jiný způsob (Rice Pudding, Another Way)
description: A pudding made with rice, lemon juice or lemon rind, and bread.
steps: Rinse the rice in hot water
Pour boiling milk over it
Let it cook slowly on a low heat until it becomes a thin porridge, about half-cooked
When it cools, beat five eggs and separate the yolks from the whites
Beat the yolks separately with sugar
Mix with the porridge
Add lemon juice or just the rind
Finally beat the egg whites separately into snow and gently fold into the porridge
Pour into a mold which has been previously buttered and sprinkled with white bread or hardtack
Place the mold in another dish with boiling water, cover it, and let it cook slowly on low heat for three-quarters of an hour
Then put it in the oven for a quarter hour so the top becomes golden
Bring every pudding immediately from the oven to table, as when it sits for a long time it becomes watery
